proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The quote listed 46 joists, 212 boards and the screw count. I thought that was overkill until the second bid just said deck, lump sum. Easy choice after that.
reviews.name: Rachel B.

reviews.text: I used the board counter on the site with our measurements and the number came out within a few boards of what Nate counted on site. No surprises on the final bill.
reviews.name: Sam K.

reviews.text: Hail chewed up our old stain every spring. They walked us through what composite does with hail and sun, and what it does not do. Straight answers, no sales pitch.
reviews.name: Gina L.

reviews.text: The ledger on our 1950s bungalow deck was rotted behind the siding. They showed us photos, replaced it with proper flashing and only then put the new boards back.
reviews.name: Omar H.

reviews.text: Horizontal cedar fence along the alley. Gaps are even all the way down, the cap is level, and the neighbors keep asking who built it.
reviews.name: Kelsey M.

reviews.text: Railing on the upper deck used to move when you leaned on it. They bolted new posts through the rim and added blocking. Rock solid now.
reviews.name: Phil T.

reviews.text: They told us the permit was needed because the deck sits over 30 inches up, handled it with the city, and the inspection passed first try.
reviews.name: Dana C.

proof.guarantee: Every board, joist and post on your quote is what we install. Count them when we are done.
